subject: Quick 15-min bridge call to review recent usage surge

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex@cascadeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Quick 15-min bridge call to review recent usage surge

Hi Alex —

Noticed CascadeAI crossed a usage bump in the last 48 hours (approx 3M tokens/day) — congrats on the growth! Our telemetry flagged a few potential optimizations (batching, prefix caching, and a small quantization profile that keeps latency but cuts cost) that usually save teams a chunk without changing prompts.

Would you be open to a short 15-minute bridge call so we can:
- Walk through the spike and expected unit costs
- Flag any immediate failure modes or throttles to watch for
- Propose a quick runbook (we'll share a 1‑page checklist)

Propose a 15-min window tomorrow or the day after. If you prefer, I can send a quick poll with 3 slots. Attached is a short checklist we use for these calls.

Thanks — looking forward to helping you stabilize and optimize throughput.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | SDR, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference
